title: wb task clean -- remove one ticket's workflow artifacts
desc:
PROBLEM: .workflow/ accumulates a directory per ticket and nothing removes one. The workaround, rm -rf .workflow/<KEY>, sits one slip away from config.json (the committed context binding) and tasks/ (the committed local backlog). Framed in .workflow/idea-dashboard/frame.md, which rejected the dashboard and server+DB shapes and kept this slice.

SCOPE: wb task clean <KEY> lists what would be removed and exits 0. --force removes .workflow/<KEY>/ and nothing else. Refuses config.json, tasks/, .events.jsonl, and an unknown key. Key validated through artifacts.validate_key, so idea-* and incident-* slugs work too.

METRIC: directories under .workflow/ stop growing monotonically; today 6.

ACCEPTANCE:
- dry-run is the default and names every file, flagging frame.md and handover.md as unrecoverable (no rollback for those; triage.json, sdd.json and evidence.json are regenerable)
- --force removes only the ticket directory; a test asserts config.json, tasks/ and .events.jsonl survive
- a test asserts a key outside .workflow/ (traversal, absolute path) is rejected before any filesystem write
- no new skill, no change to MAX_TOTAL_DESCRIPTION_CHARS in tests/test_plugin.py
- README's wb task section documents it; no SKILL.md mentions it
